# Director of Engineering, Platform — Ultimecia Systems

## Company Overview
Ultimecia Systems is a growth-stage cloud infrastructure company building the control plane for the next generation of developer platforms. We process over 8 billion API calls daily and serve 300+ engineering organizations. Our engineering team is 45 engineers strong and we are scaling to 80 over the next 18 months.

## Role Description
We are seeking a Director of Engineering to lead our Platform Engineering organization. You will own the developer platform, CI/CD infrastructure, and service reliability for all internal engineering teams. This is a senior leadership role reporting to the VP of Engineering, responsible for both technical strategy and organizational health.

## Responsibilities
* Lead a 30-40 person platform engineering organization across multiple sub-teams
* Own the technical roadmap for developer platform, CI/CD, and infrastructure services
* Drive adoption of engineering metrics frameworks (DORA, SPACE) across the org
* Build and maintain engineering governance standards for architecture review and incident management
* Partner with product engineering leadership to align platform capabilities with product needs
* Scale engineering culture through mentorship, tech talks, and internal engineering programs
* Manage relationships with cloud providers (AWS, GCP) and optimize infrastructure spend

## Requirements
* 10+ years of engineering experience, with 5+ years in engineering management
* Proven track record scaling engineering organizations or platform teams
* Deep experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP) and container orchestration (Kubernetes)
* Experience building CI/CD systems and internal developer platforms
* Strong track record of improving engineering metrics (deployment frequency, lead time, MTTR)
* Experience managing managers — you must have led a multi-team organization
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
* Experience with engineering governance frameworks and architecture review processes

## Nice to Have
* Experience with multi-region or multi-cloud deployments
* Background in cost optimization for cloud infrastructure
* Experience speaking at engineering conferences or writing technical content
* Familiarity with SOC2 or other compliance frameworks for infrastructure
